name: Beta Adoption Watcher
tagline: Shows which customers actually picked up the new feature, on a schedule
description: Watches how the product is actually being used to show which customers have genuinely picked up a new feature rather than merely logged in once, and hands the team a list worth following up with. Launch conversations move from how many accounts saw the announcement to who is really using the thing.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
